# Nabd (نبض)

> Nabd is an AI-powered medical platform for doctors and clinics. It helps doctors write structured medical reports, manage patients, clinics, assistants, waiting lists, lab tests, scans and prescriptions, and track clinic KPIs — in Arabic and English.

## Pages

- [Home (Arabic)](https://nabdassist.com/): Full product overview in Arabic.
- [Home (English)](https://nabdassist.com/en/): Full product overview in English.
- [Web app](https://app.nabdassist.com/): Sign in or start a free trial.

## Key facts

- Audience: doctors, clinics and medical practices.
- Languages: Arabic (default) and English.
- Platform: web application.
